spec.assertion: Clearing skill1 leaves totals byte-identical for EVERY slug, and no buffApply of stat damageTakenPct value 8.4 exists. Fails under the nearest-wrong model that launders an enemy DEF cut into damageTakenPct +8.4 (boss DEF is a SUBTRACTIVE formula term, damage-taken is a multiplier — and the fudge pays the whole team, not just her). Non-vacuity run S1_FUDGED proves the lastBullet trigger fires and that the fudge is detectable.

Same byte-identity assertion. No StatKey exists for boss ATK and the v1 boss deals no damage, so the line has no consumer; any encoding that moves damage is by construction unfaithful. it.skip records the missing primitive.

Trigger identity pinned as lastBullet (per-magazine), not shotFired/interval: the S1_FUDGED run injects a lastBullet-keyed block and must raise her total, proving that trigger is live and reachable with 120 ammo over 180s.
Clearing skill2 leaves totals byte-identical. No aggro/threat primitive exists and the boss targets nothing, so a faithful model contributes zero. it.skip records the reason.

No buffApply of stat damageTakenPct value 57.86 anywhere. Fails under the sign/target inversion the taxonomy names — 'Damage Taken ▲' is a boss debuff, but this is ▼ and 'Affects self', so encoding it on the enemy would be one of the largest silent damage gains on the roster. Non-vacuity run S2_FUDGED proves Full Burst is entered and the fudge is detectable.

Trigger identity pinned as fullBurstEnter, NOT burstCast. She is Burst I and the fixture carries liter (also B1), so the two triggers genuinely diverge — a burstCast keying would under-fire on rotations liter takes. S2_FUDGED firing at all establishes fullBurstEnter is reachable.

spec.kitLine: Deals 163.1% of final ATK as damage
spec.assertion: Her total must match, within 0.1%, a hand-built reference override of exactly one burstCast/enemy flatDamage atkPct 163.1. Fails under (a) a 10-instance reading of 'Affects 10 enemy unit(s)' against the single boss (~10x), (b) core:true (separately shown observable in this fixture), (c) crit-flagged or FB-boosted variants. Non-vacuity via a gauge-preserving atkPct→0 control (keeps the impact and therefore the gauge, so rotation timing is unperturbed).
Single boss → the multi-target clause collapses to ONE instance. Covered by the reference-equality assertion above; a per-target expansion is the nearest-wrong and diverges by ~10x.

noFb:true on the reference must be a strict no-op (burst-cast damage lands before the FB window opens — verified fact), and shipped must differ from the core:true variant. Fails if the engine or override grants the +50% FB major or a core bucket to burst-cast damage.

A buffApply of stat defPct value 12.93 must exist, targeting self AND at least one other ally ('all allies' includes self). Fails if the line was dropped as inert — the stat buff is kept for a future consumer even though defPct does not move v1 damage. Paired with a damage-neutrality assertion across every slug so a future defPct consumer fails loudly here.
Scope-trivial: allies take no damage at scope lock, so the gate is permanently satisfied and cannot be discriminated in either direction. Recorded as it.skip rather than asserted.

fixtures: controlComp('ludmilla', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / ludmilla (carry, focus) / helm B3, deterministic (no seed). The fixed-B3 flag is mandatory, not stylistic: ludmilla is Burst I and every skill2 line is keyed to 'entering Full Burst', so a comp without a Burst III completes no chain and those lines would be silently untestable. Nine hoisted runs: shipped, skill1-cleared, skill1-fudged, skill2-cleared, skill2-fudged, burst-atkPct-zeroed (gauge-preserving control), burst single-163.1 reference, that reference +core:true, that reference +noFb:true. All counterfactuals go through withPatchedOverride, so the committed JSON is untouched. Shape-agnostic slot helpers (getBlocks/setBlocks) handle both the Block[] and { blocks: Block[] } slot encodings, which the packet's two shape sections describe inconsistently.
gaps: GAP: DEF ▼ 8.4% on the boss — no boss-DEF-reduction StatKey exists; boss DEF is a subtractive formula term, so damageTakenPct is not an equivalent primitive and substituting it would be a fudge, not an approximation.
GAP: ATK ▼ 8.4% on the boss — boss offence is unmodeled at scope lock (the boss deals no damage), so the line has no observable payload.
GAP: Attract/Taunt for 15.09 sec — no aggro/threat primitive exists and the boss targets nothing.
GAP: self Damage Taken ▼ 57.86% for 15 sec — no incoming-damage model at scope lock.
GAP: the burst's above-50%-HP gate — permanently satisfied (allies take no damage), so it cannot be discriminated in either direction.
